proposed_facts.reason: Object 9 places this routine in the third slot, installed as gobj_proc; the rendered callback3 name is misleading.
The routine is an empty void Ground_GObj* process, distinct from the fourth callback.
The empty body and scheduler registration support the corrected purpose.
The callback clears the startup flag and returns normally; Ground stores and later invokes the event.
The initializer calls collision-joint setup, whose descriptor loop selects the {0,3,0} record for map 3.
Initialization order, deferred startup release, processing guards and color-ready producer agree with the proposed flag distinctions.

Integration, bounds, random acceleration range, multiplier increments and pointer guards match source. Exact tick guarantees are appropriately avoided.

Every successor predicate matches source, including distinct AObj flags, exact frame equality and late material/color readiness conditions.
The parameterless void routine returns normally and supplies a fully initialized color to nine copying setters.
Both state 1 and state 14 call the uniform RGBA (12,6,40,255) palette routine.
State 10 invokes the category-mask animation-rate setter with zero, clears the generator pointer after removal, then applies the fixed palette.
The void wrapper discards the generator-manager result; the cited callee returns on both success and GObj allocation failure.

contradictions.reason: Accept the three object-9 corrections: the rendered callback3 hypothesis conflicts with the actual scheduled-process slot and separate fourth callback.

Accept all 20 section-fact and four section-link deferrals. Source tables, vectors, cached parameters, colors and numeric consumers support source-object behavior, but neither address-like names nor SDATA annotations establish compiled membership, consecutive addresses, pool composition or layout. Retain supported source knowledge without promoting those section claims.

Accept corrections of non-returning terminology for the deferred callback, uniform palette routine and stage-start wrapper. These are void routines with normal returns, not demonstrated non-returning functions.
Accept the collision-participation and startup/color flag corrections. Map 3 participates in common collision setup; xC4_b27 denotes color readiness rather than releasing the startup processing gate.

Accept replacement of generator-completion language with material-overlay readiness. The cross-file producer and accessor operate on Ground.x10_flags.b4, independently of the object's generator pointer.

Accept rotation-amplitude semantics and removal of strict 180/58-update and visibility guarantees. The source establishes floating-point ramps during state residence and scaled angular motion, not exact maximum durations or movement into and out of view.

Accept coordinator corrections: state 15 is not terminal, eligibility is not uniformly a mandatory dwell gate, state 3 already enables advancement, and random rejection compares green twice rather than comparing blue.

Accept all successor-query corrections: argument 7 selects animation categories, the two flag tests differ, the controller uses six slots, and the bool/int declaration discrepancy must remain explicit rather than collapsing numeric state results into Boolean semantics.
Accept palette caller and animation-rate corrections. The uniform palette has state-1 and state-14 callers; state 10 sets selected animation rates to zero instead of starting an animation.
